zh: 最近AI圈爆火了一座草原城市，乌兰察布。
en: A grassland city has recently exploded across the AI world: Ulanqab.

zh: 华为、阿里、快手、DeepSeek，一大批AI大厂，
en: Huawei, Alibaba, Kuaishou, DeepSeek and many major AI companies

zh: 几百亿的资金，是扎堆往这里面砸。
en: are pouring tens of billions into this place.

zh: 看着这一排排的巨型机房，
en: Looking at rows of giant data halls,

zh: 我们心里会不会有一个疑问？
en: do we all have the same question?

zh: 这么宏大的算力基建，跟我们普通创业者，
en: What does infrastructure on this scale have to do with ordinary founders

zh: 跟西北本地的中小企业，到底有关系吗？
en: and local small businesses in Northwest China?

zh: 是不是只是大厂的一个游戏而已？
en: Is it only a game for the tech giants?

zh: 今天我们把这件事拆开讲一讲。
en: Today, let us break it down.

zh: 以前的乌兰察布，大家印象就是土豆之乡、草原。
en: Ulanqab used to be known for potatoes and grasslands.

zh: 现在大家叫它什么？
en: What do people call it now?

zh: 草原云谷、词元牧场。
en: Grassland Cloud Valley and a token pasture.

zh: 为什么全中国的AI大厂会跑到草原上建智算中心呢？
en: Why are major AI companies building intelligent computing centers on the grassland?

zh: 核心就这三件事。
en: It comes down to three things.

zh: 第一是什么？电便宜。
en: First, electricity is cheaper.

zh: 而且还是绿色的风电和光伏。
en: And much of it comes from wind and solar power.

zh: 跑大模型、跑AI，本质就是烧电。
en: Running large models and AI ultimately consumes electricity.

zh: 大模型训练推理，每生成百万Token，
en: For large-model training and inference, every million tokens

zh: 就要消耗好几度电。
en: can consume several kilowatt-hours of electricity.

zh: 东部城市的电价高，乌兰察布风电资源充足，
en: Power is expensive in eastern cities, while Ulanqab has abundant wind resources

zh: 综合电价低。
en: and a lower blended electricity price.

zh: 而且能帮大厂每年省下巨额的电费。
en: That can save major companies substantial power costs each year.

zh: 第二就是天气冷，天然省空调钱。
en: Second, the cold climate naturally reduces cooling costs.

zh: 服务器运行发热量巨大。
en: Servers produce enormous amounts of heat.

zh: 南方机房要24小时开大功率空调降温。
en: Data centers in the south need heavy cooling around the clock.

zh: 乌兰察布一年的平均气温只有4.3度。
en: Ulanqab has an annual average temperature of only 4.3 degrees Celsius.

zh: 一年10个月，可以直接用草原的冷空气给服务器散热，
en: For ten months a year, cold grassland air can help cool the servers

zh: 省下一大笔制冷的成本。
en: and reduce a large share of cooling costs.

zh: 第三，至关重要，离北京很近。
en: Third, and crucially, it is close to Beijing.

zh: 网络延迟低。
en: Network latency is low.

zh: 光缆直通北京，数据来回只要4毫秒左右，
en: Fiber links run directly to Beijing, with a round trip of around four milliseconds,

zh: 几乎感觉不到延迟。
en: making the delay almost imperceptible.

zh: 国家的东数西算工程，把东部大量AI计算任务放到西部，
en: China's east-data-west-computing program moves many AI workloads westward

zh: 绿电充沛的地方来跑。
en: to places rich in green electricity.

zh: 乌兰察布就是八大国家算力枢纽节点之一。
en: Ulanqab is one of the eight national computing hub nodes.

zh: 现在投运算力已经十几万P，
en: Its operating computing capacity has reached well over one hundred thousand P,

zh: 智能算力占比超过了95%。
en: with intelligent computing accounting for over 95 percent.

zh: 一大批的大模型训练、AI应用，
en: Many large-model training jobs and AI applications

zh: 都在这一片机房里面跑起来。
en: are already running inside these data centers.

zh: 讲到这里，很多人会说：那到底跟我有什么关系？
en: At this point, many people ask: what does this have to do with me?

zh: 很多中小企业老板有一个误区。
en: Many small-business owners share one misconception.

zh: 就是想做AI私有化部署、跑自己的知识库，
en: They want private AI deployment and their own knowledge base,

zh: 训练行业垂直的模型。
en: or to train a vertical industry model.

zh: 第一个反应就是：我要不要自己买GPU服务器？
en: Their first reaction is: should I buy my own GPU servers?

zh: 千万不要。
en: Do not rush into it.

zh: 一套像样的算力，硬件、电费、运维，
en: A capable computing setup brings hardware, electricity, and maintenance costs

zh: 普通企业根本扛不住。
en: that ordinary companies simply cannot carry.

zh: 乌兰察布这类算力集群真正带来的改变，
en: What computing clusters like Ulanqab really change

zh: 就是算力正在变得像水电一样，
en: is that computing is becoming more like a utility

zh: 可以按需租用的公共资源。
en: that can be rented on demand.

zh: 对于我们西北的企业来说，有三个实实在在的变化。
en: For businesses in Northwest China, this brings three concrete changes.

zh: 第一，算力成本整体往下走。
en: First, computing costs are moving downward overall.

zh: 如果做企业知识库、本地智能体，算力很贵。
en: Computing can be expensive for enterprise knowledge bases and local agents.

zh: 现在西部大规模的算力产能释放，
en: Now that large-scale computing capacity is coming online in the west,

zh: 中小企业不用重金买硬件，
en: small businesses do not need to spend heavily on hardware.

zh: 可以按需租赁算力、调用大模型，
en: They can rent computing power and call large models on demand

zh: 做私有化RAG、
en: for private RAG,

zh: 企业知识库、AI业务流程改造，
en: enterprise knowledge bases, and AI process transformation,

zh: 整体的成本都会大幅地下降。
en: bringing the overall cost down substantially.

zh: 以前只有大企业玩得起的私有化AI落地，
en: Private AI deployment used to be affordable only for large companies.

zh: 现在我们中小工厂、商贸公司、服务企业，
en: Now small factories, trading firms, and service companies

zh: 都有机会落地。
en: all have a chance to implement it.

zh: 第二就是模型的供给会变多，
en: Second, model supply will increase

zh: 本地化部署选择会变得丰富。
en: and local deployment choices will expand.

zh: 很多企业最担心的是：我的业务数据不能外流，
en: Many companies worry most about their business data leaving the company

zh: 不能传到公有的大模型。
en: or being sent to a public model.

zh: 现在很多大模型厂商，就是跑在乌兰察布
en: Many model providers now run on computing foundations

zh: 这类算力的底座之上，
en: like those in Ulanqab.

zh: 可以给企业做本地私有化的部署，
en: They can support local private deployments for businesses,

zh: 数据不出本地服务器，兼顾AI能力和数据安全。
en: keeping data on local servers while balancing AI capability and data security.

zh: 这也是我们现在做企业AI落地，
en: This is also an important external condition

zh: 非常重要的一个外部环境。
en: for the enterprise AI work we are doing.

zh: 算力底座越充足，
en: The more abundant the computing foundation,

zh: 中小企业做AI改造的门槛就越低。
en: the lower the barrier for small businesses to adopt AI.

zh: 第三，就是咱们的算力下游的应用服务。
en: Third comes downstream application services.

zh: 机房、服务器重资产，是资本玩的。
en: Data centers and servers are capital-intensive infrastructure.

zh: 但是把算力包装成行业的解决方案，
en: But turning computing power into an industry solution

zh: 给本地企业做培训，
en: and providing training for local companies,

zh: 做知识库，
en: building knowledge bases,

zh: 做工作流改造，
en: redesigning workflows,

zh: 做AIGC内容赋能，
en: and enabling AIGC content

zh: 这些恰恰是我们这类服务商的机会。
en: are exactly where service providers like us have an opportunity.

zh: 硬件在草原，
en: The hardware sits on the grassland,

zh: 但业务落地发生在我们每一座城市的实体企业里。
en: but implementation happens inside real businesses in every city.

zh: 算力是武器，
en: Computing power is the weapon,

zh: 但怎么用武器解决生意的问题，
en: but knowing how to use it to solve business problems

zh: 才是大多数企业真正付费的地方。
en: is what most companies actually pay for.

zh: 对于普通人想入局AI，
en: For ordinary people who want to enter AI,

zh: 是不是要跑去乌兰察布的机房上班？
en: should they run to a data center in Ulanqab for a job?

zh: 这里我们客观地看待。
en: We need to look at this objectively.

zh: 我们不制造暴富的幻想。
en: We are not selling fantasies of sudden wealth.

zh: 机房高薪岗位和机房核心的运维，
en: High-paying data-center roles and core operations work,

zh: 还有AI的训练师、
en: as well as AI training roles,

zh: 工程师门槛其实很高。
en: have a genuinely high technical threshold.

zh: 需要专业的技术背景。
en: They require a professional technical background.

zh: 不是普通人直接就能上岗拿得高薪。
en: They are not jobs where anyone can immediately earn a high salary.

zh: 但产业链拉长之后，
en: But as the industry chain expands,

zh: 普通人的机会不在上游烧钱建机房，
en: opportunities for ordinary people are not in funding upstream data centers

zh: 而是在下游。
en: but in downstream work.

zh: 第一种就是咱们的技能岗位：
en: The first path is skills-based work:

zh: 数据标注、AI训练师、
en: data annotation and AI training,

zh: 内容审核。
en: plus content review.

zh: 还有一些依托算力集群大量释放，
en: Some opportunities are also being released around computing clusters

zh: 可以远程接单的，普通人经过训练，
en: and may be handled remotely after training,

zh: 就可以切入的一些入门路径。
en: providing possible entry paths for ordinary people.

zh: 第二种就是超级个体路线，
en: The second path is the super-individual route,

zh: 也就是我常说的OPC。
en: what I often call OPC.

zh: 普通人不需要拥有算力硬件。
en: Ordinary people do not need to own computing hardware.

zh: 你只需要懂业务，
en: You need to understand the business

zh: 懂怎么用AI去解决行业的痛点。
en: and how to use AI to solve industry pain points.

zh: 算力底座由这些大的智算中心提供，
en: Large intelligent computing centers provide the infrastructure,

zh: 然后你作为一个个体创业者、顾问，
en: while you work as an independent founder or consultant

zh: 面向本地商家做AI培训、做方案，
en: delivering AI training and solutions to local businesses

zh: 做落地交付。
en: and completing the implementation.

zh: 算力是别人的，
en: The computing power belongs to someone else.

zh: 业务理解、客户、服务，是你的核心资产。
en: Your business understanding, customers, and service are your core assets.

zh: 不是凭空靠AI变出能力，
en: AI does not create ability out of thin air.

zh: 是借助外部的算力大底座，
en: It lets you use an external computing foundation

zh: 放大你原本行业的经验。
en: to amplify the industry experience you already have.

zh: 所以总结一句话：
en: So, to sum it up:

zh: 乌兰察布算力火爆这件事，
en: The boom in Ulanqab's computing industry

zh: 表面上看是草原上一座座服务器的机房，
en: looks like rows of server halls on the grassland,

zh: 本质是整个AI时代的基础设施正在成熟。
en: but it really shows that AI infrastructure is maturing.

zh: 大厂负责砸钱造“发电厂”，
en: Large companies spend heavily to build the power plants,

zh: 生产源源不断的算力。
en: producing a continuous supply of computing power.

zh: 而我们中小企业、超级个体要思考的是，
en: Small businesses and super individuals need to think about

zh: 怎么用好这个电，改造自己的业务。
en: how to use that power to transform their own business.

zh: AI离我们并不远。
en: AI is not far away from us.

zh: 未来拉开距离的，不是谁拥有服务器，
en: The future gap will not be defined by who owns servers,

zh: 而是谁懂得利用现成的算力，
en: but by who knows how to use available computing power

zh: 解决真实生意的痛点。
en: to solve real business pain points.

zh: 如果你是企业老板，
en: If you are a business owner,

zh: 你现在有没有想过，你的业务里面哪一块工作，
en: have you thought about which part of your business

zh: 可以借助越来越便宜的算力，用AI来重构？
en: could be rebuilt with AI as computing becomes cheaper?

zh: 评论区留下你的想法。
en: Leave your thoughts in the comments.

zh: 我给您免费拆解。
en: I will break it down for you for free.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
